content: TommyPROM (well-known Arduino parallel-EEPROM programmer) 28C256 SDP notes: the SDP load bytes must each occur within tBLC (byte-load cycle time), the same constraint as a page write. tBLC max is 150us on Atmel parts but only 100us on Xicor and ON Semi/Catalyst parts. Xicor is forgiving (works near 200us); Atmel REFUSES to unlock when timing exceeds max - i.e. an over-slow host silently fails to unlock. Root cause in Arduino implementations is host speed: digitalWrite-per-pin is too slow, direct port access is required. Also reports that new chips often ship LOCKED despite datasheets stating SDP-disabled-from-factory. Verified chips: AT28C256-15PU, CAT28C256P-12, X28C256P.
